thread:
ashwin: Kicked off KV-cache quantization runs on tsm-70b. Comparing INT8-KV vs FP8-KV with a preload/prefetch shim. Looking for cold-start tail behavior + memory vs latency tradeoffs. Results here as I get them.

maria: Nice — are these end-to-end with prefix caching enabled or KV-only?

ashwin: KV-only path for this round (we want pure KV behavior). Prefetch=1 for simulated user prefix. Batch=1 to stress latency.

kevin: FYI ran a first pass. Command I used:```./bench_kv_quant --model tsm-70b --quant int8 --kv-only --prefetch=1 --batch=1 --requests=1000 --warmup=50```

kevin: Raw 95th/99th latencies: INT8-KV = 36ms / 122ms, FP8-KV = 42ms / 178ms on A100-40G. Memory: INT8-KV ~= 42GB, FP8-KV ~= 60GB. Throughput at batch1 similar.

sophie: Interesting — INT8 is both smaller and lower tail? Any quality diffs?

kevin: Ran a quick eval on 1k prompts (synthed chat + snippets). Token-level divergence: INT8-KV vs FP32 baseline = 0.9% token mismatch. FP8-KV vs FP32 = 1.1%. So both small, INT8 slightly better here.

maria: Did you compare GPTQ/AWQ artifacts or only standard quant?

kevin: This batch was symmetric int8 quant on KV matrices + AWQ-style asymmetric trial pending. GPTQ requires offline recompile; scheduled next.

ashwin: Note: cold-start under prefill showed a 2x spike for FP8-KV 99th when cache miss chain triggered dequant path. Repro: set requests=1, random prefixes -> FP8 99th ~ 360ms, INT8 ~ 220ms. So FP8 has a heavier dequant penalty in our runtime.

maria: Can you paste the minimal repro snippet?

kevin:```# repro
for i in range(50):
  res = client.generate(model="tsm-70b", quant="fp8-kv", prompt=random_prefix(), max_tokens=8)
  sleep(0.05)
```

kevin: Stack show points to dequant kernel on kv_read -> memcpy -> convert path. We might be able to optimize with a direct fused dequant + copy kernel.

ashwin: From quality side, ran the MMLU micro subset (20 tasks): INT8-KV avg acc drop = 0.7% absolute, FP8-KV = 1.2% absolute. Both within acceptable guardrail for many customers but depends on SLA.

ops-bot: nightly-run:kv-quant-bench completed — artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-ci/kv-quant/2421103333/ (logs, perf.csv, diffs.json) :white_check_mark:

maria: Good. For rollout I'd suggest a shadow run first (traffic=5%) using INT8-KV on Dedicated pool with automatic fallback to FP32 model when divergence > 0.03 or token-likelihood delta crosses threshold. Also instrument per-route evals.

ashwin: Agreed. Action items: 1) kevin -> run AWQ/GPTQ variants and attach diffs.json by EOD. 2) eng-runtime -> estimate cost delta if we can fuse dequant kernel (kevin/ashwin pair). 3) maria -> prepare canary plan (shadow 5%, observe logits divergence, perf).

kevin: Starting AWQ/GPTQ runs now. Expect initial results in ~3h, will post summary + diffs.

sophie: One more datapoint: did memory reduction change autoscaler behavior in Dedicated? In some cases dropping mem by 18GB allowed one extra shard per GPU which improved cost by ~12%. Worth modeling.

ashwin: Great catch. Add to rollout doc. If anyone finds a big fidelity regression (>1.5% on MMLU-subset or >2% on QA accuracy), hold on rollout. Otherwise INT8-KV looks promising for latency and cost.

maria: ack.

kevin: uploading AWQ artifacts now. Will summarize in thread with CSVs and small table.

ashwin: thanks all — marking this thread as the experimental channel for this trial. Ping me for any blockers. :rocket:
